title: Android & IoT Software Development Intern
description:
Android & IoT Software Development Intern

**Company:** OORO  
**Location:** India (Remote)  
**Employment Type:** Part-time Internship  
**Duration:** 3–6 Months  
**Stipend:** ₹8,000–₹15,000/month (proposed range)

About OORO

OORO is building a smart, connected digital advertising ecosystem that transforms everyday vehicles into technology-powered advertising networks.

Our platform combines Android-based display systems, real-time device management, GPS technology, cloud infrastructure, and intelligent advertising delivery.

We're looking for a passionate **Android & IoT Software Development Intern** who enjoys building real-world applications, working with connected hardware, and solving challenging engineering problems.

What You'll Work On

* Develop and maintain Android applications using Kotlin and Android SDK.
* Build and improve our Android Screen Player for digital advertising displays.
* Work on DeviceOS, our Android-based device management and monitoring system.
* Implement remote device configuration, health monitoring, and OTA application updates.
* Develop offline-first media playback, local caching, and synchronization systems.
* Integrate GPS tracking, location services, and backend APIs.
* Implement device pairing, authentication, and secure communication.
* Improve device performance, reliability, and automated recovery mechanisms.
* Debug Android applications using ADB, Logcat, and physical hardware testing.
* Collaborate on Android driver application features, including onboarding and device operations.
* Work closely with our full-stack development team to integrate devices with cloud services.
* Write clean, maintainable, and testable code.

Required Technical Skills

* Kotlin or Java for Android development.
* Android SDK and Android application lifecycle.
* REST API integration and JSON.
* Basic understanding of Android background services.
* Git and GitHub.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving abilities.
* Experience building and running Android applications.

Good to Have

* Jetpack Compose and modern Android architecture.
* Kotlin Coroutines and WorkManager.
* Media3 / ExoPlayer for video playback.
* Room Database and offline data synchronization.
* Android kiosk mode and Device Owner concepts.
* GPS and location-based services.
* MQTT, WebSockets, or IoT communication protocols.
* OTA application update mechanisms.
* Linux, Docker, and cloud infrastructure fundamentals.
* Experience working with Android-based embedded devices.

You don't need to know every technology listed. We're looking for someone with strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly.

Who Should Apply?

* Computer Science, Electronics, IT, or related students and recent graduates.
* Developers who have built Android applications or worked on IoT projects.
* Candidates interested in connected devices, embedded Android, and real-world hardware.
* Individuals who enjoy debugging, experimenting, and solving complex technical challenges.
* Self-motivated builders comfortable collaborating remotely.

**Working Android applications, GitHub repositories, and practical projects matter more to us than certificates.**

What You'll Gain

* Hands-on experience with real Android-powered connected devices.
* Opportunity to develop technology used in physical advertising systems.
* Direct collaboration with OORO's founding team.
* Exposure to Android engineering, IoT, cloud infrastructure, and real-time systems.
* Experience working on production-oriented software and hardware integrations.
* Flexible remote working arrangements.
* Internship completion certificate upon successful completion.
* Potential full-time opportunity based on performance and business requirements.

Hiring Process

* **Application Screening:** Review of resume, GitHub, and Android/IoT projects.
* **Technical Discussion:** Android fundamentals, architecture, APIs, and debugging.
* **Practical Assessment:** A short Android development or debugging challenge.
* **Founder Interview:** Discussion about project ownership, availability, and expectations.

How to Apply

Apply through LinkedIn with:

* Updated resume
* GitHub profile
* Links to Android applications or IoT projects
* Brief explanation of your most challenging technical project
* Weekly availability and earliest joining date

Applicant Privacy

Applicant information will be used solely for recruitment and selection, accessible only to the authorized hiring team, and not shared for unrelated marketing purposes. Applications will be handled in accordance with applicable privacy requirements.

**Build Software. Connect Hardware. Create Real-World Impact.**

At OORO, you won't just develop another mobile application. You'll help build intelligent systems that connect software, physical devices, and real-world advertising.

**If you enjoy building technology that goes beyond the screen, we'd love to hear from you.**

Pay: ₹8,000.00 - ₹13,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Android Developer
description:
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 3.5+ Years  
**Role:** Android Developer

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Android Developer** with a minimum of **3.5 years of hands-on experience in native Android application development**. The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of **Kotlin, Java, Android SDK, Fragments, Android lifecycle, MVVM/MVI, REST APIs, Retrofit, Coroutines, and Dagger/Hilt**.

You will be responsible for developing, maintaining, debugging, and optimizing production-level Android applications while following clean, scalable, and maintainable coding practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain native Android applications.
* Build scalable and maintainable applications using **Kotlin and Java**.
* Work with **MVVM/MVI, Repository Pattern, Clean Architecture**, and modular application structures.
* Develop Android UI using **Activities, Fragments, XML, RecyclerView, ViewBinding/DataBinding**, and Material Design.
* Handle **Activity and Fragment lifecycle**, configuration changes, navigation, and back-stack management.
* Integrate REST APIs using **Retrofit and OkHttp**.
* Implement proper API error handling, timeouts, retries, and network-failure scenarios.
* Use **Kotlin Coroutines, Flow, LiveData, ViewModel, Lifecycle components, and WorkManager**.
* Implement dependency injection using **Dagger/Hilt**, including modules, scopes, and ViewModel injection.
* Work with local data storage using **Room, DataStore, SharedPreferences**, or similar technologies.
* Debug and resolve **crashes, ANRs, memory leaks, performance issues, and production defects**.
* Optimize application performance, startup time, memory usage, and responsiveness.
* Follow Android security, lifecycle, performance, and coding best practices.
* Use Git for branching, merging, pull requests, and conflict resolution.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving overall code quality.
* Understand existing production code and enhance it without impacting existing functionality.

**Required Technical Skills Android**

* Strong hands-on experience with native Android development.
* Good understanding of **Android SDK, Android Studio, Gradle**, and Android project structure.
* Strong knowledge of **Activity and Fragment lifecycle**.
* Experience with Fragment transactions, Navigation Component, back-stack handling, and lifecycle-aware components.
* Understanding of Android permissions, services, broadcast receivers, notifications, and background execution limitations.

**Kotlin & Java**

* Strong hands-on experience with **Kotlin**.
* Good working knowledge of **Java**.
* Strong understanding of OOP, collections, null safety, extension functions, data classes, sealed classes, and Kotlin best practices.
* Ability to write clean, readable, reusable, and maintainable code.

**Architecture**

* Strong practical experience with **MVVM**.
* Understanding of **MVI and Clean Architecture** is an advantage.
* Experience with Repository Pattern, separation of concerns, use cases, and modular application design.

**Dependency Injection**

* Hands-on experience with **Dagger or Hilt**.
* Understanding of modules, dependency injection, scopes, qualifiers, and ViewModel injection.

Jetpack Components

**Hands-on experience with:**

* ViewModel
* LiveData
* Kotlin Flow
* Lifecycle Components
* Navigation Component
* Room Database
* WorkManager
* Paging Library, if applicable

**Networking**

* Experience integrating REST APIs.
* Strong knowledge of **Retrofit and OkHttp**.
* Experience with interceptors and authentication mechanisms.
* Knowledge of JSON parsing using **Gson, Moshi, or Kotlin Serialization**.
* Ability to handle network failures, timeouts, retries, and slow-network conditions.

**Git & Collaboration**

* Good working knowledge of Git.
* Experience with branching, merging, pull requests, and conflict resolution.
* Comfortable participating in code reviews and technical discussions.

Education

**Required:** Bachelor's or equivalent degree in:

* Computer Science
* Information Technology
* Software Engineering
* Computer Applications
* Any directly related Computer/IT discipline

**Preferred:** Master's degree such as **MCA, M.Sc. Computer Science, M.Tech, or equivalent**.

CDAC Candidates

CDAC candidates are eligible **only if their prior academic qualification is in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a directly related computer discipline**.

Experience Requirements

* Minimum **3.5 years of professional, hands-on Android application development experience**.
* Experience should primarily involve **native Android development and production applications**.
* Candidates whose experience is limited mainly to support activities, testing, or minor bug fixing may not be suitable for this role.

Good to Have

* Experience with Clean Architecture and modular Android projects.
* Firebase experience, including **Crashlytics, Analytics, FCM, or Remote Config**.
* Experience with Google Maps and location services.
* Experience with payment gateway integration.
* Knowledge of Android performance profiling and memory-leak detection.
* Experience with Play Store release and deployment processes.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience working with large-scale or production Android applications.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should:

* Be able to independently own and deliver Android modules/features.
* Have strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Understand Android lifecycle and write lifecycle-safe code.
* Be comfortable working with an existing production codebase.
* Follow clean coding and architecture principles.
* Focus on application performance, stability, and maintainability.
* Communicate technical issues clearly with the development team.
* Be proactive in identifying and resolving technical challenges.

Why Join Us?

* Opportunity to work on **real-world production Android applications**.
* Work with modern Android technologies and architecture.
* Opportunity to solve challenging performance, scalability, and application lifecycle problems.
* Collaborative environment with opportunities to improve technical and architectural skills.

title: Senior Android Platform Security Engineer
description:

**About the Job**

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Android Platform Security team, you will architect, design, develop, and validate critical hardware-backed security modules that protect billions of Android devices worldwide. You will work across the entire Android security stack—from Java framework APIs and Rust/C++ system daemons (keystore2) down to AIDL Hardware Abstraction Layers (HALs), Trusted Execution Environments (Trusty OS), and Secure Elements (JavaCard / StrongBox).

In this role, you will lead complex features involving cryptographic key management, hardware attestation, Remote Key Provisioning (RKP), and compliance verification through CTS and VTS suites.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Design & Development**: Architect, develop, and maintain core Android security components including Android Keystore, KeyMint (and StrongBox KeyMint), Trusty OS Trusted Applications (TAs), and JavaCard applets for Secure Elements (eSE).
* **HAL & IPC Integration**: Define, implement, and evolve AIDL-based HALs and Binder IPC interfaces connecting the Android OS framework with underlying TEE and Secure Element hardware.
* **Cryptography & PKI**: Implement and review cryptographic protocols, hardware-backed key generation, key attestation, X.509 certificate chain validation, and secure storage mechanisms.
* **Testing & Compliance**: Author, maintain, and debug CTS (Compatibility Test Suite) and VTS (Vendor Test Suite) tests to ensure ecosystem-wide security compliance and robustness across SoC vendors and OEMs.
* **Cross-Stack Debugging:** Triage, root-cause, and resolve complex functional, performance, and security issues spanning Java framework services, native C++/Rust system daemons, kernel drivers, TEEs, and Secure Elements.
* **Technical Leadership**: Provide technical mentorship, drive security design reviews, Threat Modeling, and code reviews in C++, Rust, and Java, ensuring adherence to memory safety and secure coding best practices.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* **Education**: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Experience**: 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience in embedded systems, OS internals, or mobile platform security.
* **Programming Languages**: Strong proficiency in C++, Rust, and Java (including JavaCard for Secure Element applet development where applicable).
* **Android Security Core**: Deep hands-on experience with Android Keystore, KeyMint (or Keymaster), Trusty OS (or equivalent TEEs like OP-TEE/QTEE), and Secure Elements (eSE / StrongBox).
* **Interfaces**: Proven experience developing and integrating Android HALs using AIDL (and HIDL) and Binder IPC.
* **Cryptography**: Solid foundation in applied cryptography (AES, RSA, ECC/ECDSA/ECDH, SHA/HMAC, KDFs), PKI, X.509 certificates, and hardware key attestation.
* **Validation**: Hands-on experience developing, executing, and debugging Android CTS and VTS test suites.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with **Rust in AOSP** (e.g., keystore2, KeyMint Rust reference implementation, or Trusty Rust TAs).
* Experience with **JavaCard** applet development, GlobalPlatform specifications, APDU command protocols, and OMAPI.
* Knowledge of **Remote Key Provisioning (RKP)**, CBOR/COSE data structures, DICE (Device Identifier Composition Engine), or Android Virtualization Framework (AVF / pKVM).
* Familiarity with side-channel mitigation, fuzz testing (libFuzzer), static/dynamic analysis tools, and hardware security certification standards.
* Track record of contributing to the Android Open Source Project (AOSP) and collaborating with SoC vendors, OEMs, or Secure Element vendors.
